scope: Independent read-only review of the ten current task input packages: six retained first-screen failures plus boson-transfer-noise, elastic-ring, emitter-lifetime and metal-plate-force. Reviewed instruction, README, entire public starter, public tests/data keys, Docker boundary and private grading restrictions. Native user prompts checked when current-source sessions were present. No task file was edited.
limits: This is a source/provenance audit, not a proof of adversarial container isolation or absence of all statistical side channels.
A fit-only placeholder alongside a completed predictor can anchor the agent; the instruction explicitly permits replacing every helper. No guarantee of behavioral neutrality is claimed.
Unknown-parameter fields, output shapes and numerical accuracy gates are required. Solvers, bases, numerical resolution and internal formulas are not prescribed by tests.

Response-scaled global uncertainties in three older retained families are a metadata hygiene concern for future generation, not demonstrated answer leakage in the current public package. No private generation fractions are agent-visible.
